red_1_static_mismatch.verdict: SEMANTIC_AUTHORITY_GAP — the durable projection rows say BTC while Bloc5Handoff exposes VERIFIED_NATIVE/SOL; the commit is not truth-bound to row evidence.

selected_repair_shape.claim_truth_law: VERIFIED_NATIVE means ONLY: the declared provider-native lexeme is proven invariant across the committed projection evidence for the declared unit-bearing field/path. T0B commit proves all non-null values agree with the declared lexeme before durable publication; mismatch, mixed distinct lexemes, or an all-null column are typed refusals (ProjectionUnitEvidenceConflict) with safe metadata only.
selected_repair_shape.commit_boundary: write_projection, after the Arrow table is built and schema-equality proven, before staging/publication. No row scanning in Bloc5Handoff; truth is established at the T0B commit boundary and remains re-provable from durable schema + durable rows.
selected_repair_shape.contract_marker: explicit source_unit_contract marker (NO_UNIT_FIELDS | UNIT_EVIDENCE_DECLARED) distinguishes an explicit no-unit-fields declaration from a historical/undeclared contract without rewriting historical descriptors.
selected_repair_shape.empty_declaration: absent marker + empty list = HISTORICAL_UNIT_CONTRACT_ABSENT; NO_UNIT_FIELDS marker + empty list = explicit no-unit-bearing-fields; UNIT_EVIDENCE_DECLARED + nonempty list = declared evidence. No inference from list emptiness where the marker is present.
selected_repair_shape.null_law: all values null => static claim REFUSED (no vacuous verification, no implicit fill); some null + all non-null values == declared lexeme => accepted (null is absence of a value, not disagreement); some null + any differing non-null value => REFUSED.
selected_repair_shape.resource_law: distinct-state scanning only (0 / 1 / >1 distinct lexemes, one remembered lexeme, null count, rows inspected); chunked Arrow traversal; conflict short-circuits; no all-values collection.
selected_repair_shape.unknown_law: UNIT_UNVERIFIED never carries a lexeme and never auto-promotes from row bytes; ROW_NATIVE declares only the durable location of per-row/per-level native units.
selected_repair_shape.variability_law: STATIC_VERIFIED requires state=VERIFIED_NATIVE + lexeme; UNIT_UNVERIFIED requires state=UNIT_UNVERIFIED + no lexeme; ROW_NATIVE requires state=UNIT_UNVERIFIED + no lexeme and marks a durable per-row/per-level location; absent variability preserves the I16R1 pair semantics exactly.
selected_repair_shape.verification_model: I16R2's vocabulary adds no conversion, no canonical unit, no effective_at, no Bloc-5 normalization: WHERE native unit truth lives is preserved (Bloc 4); per-row interpretation remains Bloc 5.

t0b_representation_audit.arrow_descriptor_capability: _arrow_type_descriptor/_rebuild_arrow_type in storage/projection_schema.py are lossless for list, large_list, struct, map (verified in this tree) and fail closed on dictionary/union.
